contract: UI_UX_AUDIT_REPORT.md: Modern Vietnamese Cooking App, mobile-first; bounded desktop layout; no horizontal overflow; persistent mobile navigation that does not cover content; clear incomplete-recipe and quantity states.

accessibility.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse Accessibility score 100; color contrast audit passed. Manually verified labelled dialog, focus containment, Escape close, focus return, and visible focus treatment. Formal screen-reader testing remains outstanding.

responsive.evidence: Browser emulation at 320x640, 375x812, 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, and 1440x900; document width equalled viewport at each. At 320px mobile shell reserves separate rows for CTA/navigation while main content scrolls independently.

loading.reason: Recipe and ingredient data are statically bundled; this interface has no asynchronous content-loading state.

empty.evidence: Empty fridge state explains the next action and provides the ingredient picker plus cook CTA.

error.evidence: Uploaded malformed JSON to the local backup import; app showed a clear invalid-structure alert. After dismissing it, the settings page remained usable and fridge stock stayed empty.

partial.evidence: Explore cards explicitly label Copper entries as ingredient-only with no instructions; detail shows missing amounts and source.

success.evidence: Adding a test egg updated stock count and recommendation; removing it restored the empty fridge.

permission.reason: No camera, location, microphone, sign-in, or operating-system permission is requested by these tested screens.

renderedEvidence.observation: Phone-small app shell, no horizontal overflow, CTA and navigation do not overlap the independently scrolling fridge content.
